newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish Sept CPI seen up 2.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish Sept CPI seen up 2.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Danish consumer prices were expected to have risen 2.3 percent year-on-year in September, according to a Reuter consensus survey, compared to an actual August year-on-year rise of 2.4 percent.
The panel of eight economists forecast an average monthly rise of 0.5 percent for September compared to 0.2 percent in August.

The forecasts, ranging from a low of 2.1 to a high of 2.4 percent, referred to data calculated by the Danish domestic formula. They did not predict data formulated by EU methods, which are released simultaneously at 0730 GMT on October 21.
